user.title: Subscribe to a Google Maps list
user.description: Enter a shared Google Maps list URL that opens without signing in. Private lists are not supported. Add another integration entry for each additional list.

settings.title: Zone settings
settings.description: Zones will be created automatically. Enable removal only if places deleted from the list should also be removed from Home Assistant. Passive zones can trigger automations but do not change a person’s location name.

data.label: Default group (Home Assistant label; blank for none)
data.remove_missing: Remove zones for places deleted from the list

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Google Maps. Try again later.
error.not_shared_list: The link must open a shared list without signing in.
error.invalid_response: Google returned incomplete or unrecognised list data. No zones were changed.
error.list_too_large: Lists with 500 or more places are not supported yet.

place.title: Choose a place
place.description: Choose a zone from this list to override its name, icon or additional groups.

customize.title: Customize place
customize.description:
Google Maps name: {place}

Leave a name or icon blank to follow the source name or default icon. Overrides survive refreshes and restarts. The default group “{default_group}” is always applied; choose any additional groups below. Groups use Home Assistant labels.
